seo.title: Debt Collection & AR Dashboards | CloudTopia
seo.description: Custom debt collection and accounts receivable dashboards that surface aging, automate follow-ups, and cut DSO so cash lands faster. Book a free consultation.

hero.title: Debt Collection & Accounts Receivable Dashboards
hero.subtitle: See every unpaid invoice, who owes what, and how overdue it is on one live dashboard. We build collection workflows that chase the right customer at the right time, so cash lands faster and nothing slips through.

deliver.name: Live Receivables Dashboard
deliver.description: A single screen showing total outstanding, overdue balance, and cash expected this week, refreshed from your accounting system rather than a stale export.

deliver.name: Aging Buckets & Watchlist
deliver.description: Invoices sorted into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ day buckets, with a watchlist that flags accounts the moment they cross your risk thresholds.

deliver.name: Collection Workflow Engine
deliver.description: Rule-based dunning sequences that move each overdue account through reminder, call, and escalation stages without anyone keeping a manual list.

deliver.name: Automated Reminders & Statements
deliver.description: Scheduled payment reminders and account statements sent over WhatsApp and email in Arabic or English, timed to your dunning calendar.

deliver.name: Promise-to-Pay & Notes Log
deliver.description: Collectors log every call outcome, dispute, and payment commitment against the invoice, so the next person sees the full history instantly.

deliver.name: Collector Performance & Reports
deliver.description: Per-collector queues and scorecards that show who is recovering what, alongside DSO and recovery-rate reports for management.

outcomes.label: Lower DSO
outcomes.description: Faster, consistent follow-up shortens the gap between invoice and payment, pulling cash forward instead of letting balances age.

outcomes.label: Fewer write-offs
outcomes.description: Early risk flags and a live watchlist catch slow payers before balances slide past 90 days and turn into bad debt.

outcomes.label: Hours back each week
outcomes.description: Automated reminders and ready-made collector queues replace the manual chasing, spreadsheets, and reconciliation your finance team does today.

outcomes.label: Clear accountability
outcomes.description: Every account has an owner, a next action, and a logged history, so nothing goes quiet and management always knows the real position.

faqs.question: Can it pull invoices straight from our accounting system?
faqs.answer: Yes. We connect the dashboard to your existing accounting or ERP, whether that is QuickBooks, Zoho, Odoo, Tally, or a SQL database, so balances and payments stay in sync. You keep working in your accounting system, and the dashboard reflects it without any double entry.

faqs.question: Will reminders work in Arabic and over WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes. The reminders, statements, and dashboard itself ship fully bilingual and RTL-ready, and we wire up WhatsApp and email so you reach customers on the channel they actually read. You set the wording and timing for each dunning stage.

faqs.question: Do we own the system, or are we tied to you?
faqs.answer: You own the code, the data, and the documentation outright, with no vendor lock-in. If you ever want to host it yourself or hand it to another team, everything is yours to take. We build around how your collections process actually runs, not a rigid template.

faqs.question: Can different collectors see only their own accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Role-based access lets each collector work their assigned queue while managers see the full book and team scorecards. You decide who can view balances, log promises, or trigger escalations.

faqs.question: Can we see it before committing?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We offer a free consultation and a demo preview built around your aging data and workflow, so you can see exactly how it would chase your overdue accounts before any commitment. The fastest way to start is a quick message on WhatsApp.

techStack.title: The stack we build this on
techStack.subtitle: Proven, ownable tools chosen to sync cleanly with your books and automate follow-ups reliably.
